audience: merchants and store teams who check products, orders and stock in Shopify

useCases.title: Find products that are low on stock
useCases.text: List products with their total inventory. Read one product to see the stock of its first 50 variants, then read the stock levels at one location.

useCases.title: Review orders that are not fulfilled yet
useCases.text: List recent orders with their payment and fulfillment status. Open one order to read its line items. No customer personal data is returned.

useCases.title: Count active products from one vendor
useCases.text: Count the products that match a search query such as status active and a vendor name. List the matching products to see their stock.

useCases.title: Set the stock of a variant only if it is unchanged
useCases.text: Read the current available quantity at a location. Then set the new quantity. The change applies only if the stock still has the value you read.

useCases.title: Browse the store and its collections
useCases.text: Read the store details to confirm which store is connected. List the product collections with their product counts.
